label: setup
purpose: Create output directories and require the analysis inputs; halt on errors.

label: packages
purpose: Load estimation, panel, data-manipulation, and table packages.

label: load-panel
purpose: Read the seasonally adjusted bank panel and treasury holdings.

label: filter-panel
purpose: Apply bank-variable eligibility, outlier rules, and the 1997 Q2–2023 Q2 sample; require 427375 observations.

label: table-1
purpose: Compute and export descriptive statistics for Table 1.

label: macro-data
purpose: Construct quarterly rate, uncertainty, and macro controls; merge into the bank panel and export figure inputs.

label: table-2-labels
purpose: Define labels and control groups for the main profit regressions.

label: table-2
purpose: Estimate and export the NIM, NNI, and ROA regressions with term-premium decomposition.

label: table-2-sample-check
purpose: Require 420772 observations in each main regression.

label: table-3-labels
purpose: Define channel-regression labels and control groups.

label: table-3
purpose: Estimate loan-share, loan-provision, maturity-gap, loan-income, and treasury-share channels.

label: subsample-labels
purpose: Define profit and control labels for the subsample regressions.

label: subsample-groups
purpose: Construct within-quarter maturity-gap and asset-size terciles and the zero-derivatives indicator.

label: table-9
purpose: Estimate and export NIM regressions for the full sample and six subsamples.

label: table-10
purpose: Estimate and export NNI regressions for the full sample and six subsamples.

label: did-maturity-sample
purpose: Select the outer maturity-gap terciles for the interaction regressions.

label: table-4-maturity
purpose: Estimate NIM slopes interacted with groups defined by maturity-gap terciles.

label: table-4-size
purpose: Estimate NIM slopes interacted with groups defined by asset-size terciles.

label: table-4-derivatives
purpose: Estimate NIM slopes interacted with groups defined by interest-rate derivative use.

label: table-4-labels
purpose: Define group-interaction labels for NIM.

label: table-4-output
purpose: Export Table 4 group-interaction coefficients and standard errors.

label: table-5-maturity
purpose: Estimate NNI slopes interacted with groups defined by maturity-gap terciles.

label: table-5-size
purpose: Estimate NNI slopes interacted with groups defined by asset-size terciles.

label: table-5-derivatives
purpose: Estimate NNI slopes interacted with groups defined by interest-rate derivative use.

label: table-5-labels
purpose: Define group-interaction labels for NNI.

label: table-5-output
purpose: Export Table 5 group-interaction coefficients and standard errors.

label: session-info
purpose: Write R session information for the analysis run.
